PhaseCompletionResult.reason: INVALID_INPUT | EVIDENCE_MISMATCH | NOT_READY | USAGE_UNKNOWN | BUDGET_EXHAUSTED | PUBLICATION_FAILED | VERIFIED
PhaseCompletionResult.current_tokens: null on NOT_ADMITTED, else exact nonnegative int
PhaseCompletionResult.campaign_tokens: null on NOT_ADMITTED, else exact nonnegative int <120000

error_semantics: complete_phase returns PhaseCompletionResult, catches Exception only with fixed safe reason. Never propagate exception strings/payload, never catch BaseException as success. Malformed config ->INVALID_INPUT; missing/binding invalid ->EVIDENCE_MISMATCH; typed STOP/nonREADY ->NOT_READY or exact USAGE_UNKNOWN/BUDGET_EXHAUSTED. No files if verification fails. Publication errors ->PUBLICATION_FAILED and preserve owned partial record; no retry. Success reason VERIFIED.
initial_schema: Existing argo-house-price-a2-handoff/v1 exact field set in option-a2-context-permission-contract-v1.json; no extensions. FileBinding serialization {path:str,sha256:str,bytes:int,mtime_ns_max:int}. Run IDs sorted.

final_schema.native_gate_outcome: FileBinding of exact latest >=1 v2 gate output from validated history, chosen from native private outcome directory not config arbitraryfilename
final_schema.bridge_config: FileBinding rederived from gate config binding
final_schema.verified_dev_run_ids: sorted list two or three eligible devUUIDs from actual verified views
final_schema.final_lock: asdict existing exact12field FinalArtifactLock; downstream must rederive

native_gate_selection: Read exactly the maximum contiguous sequence single record, require no .gate-evaluation.lock and no partial/missing record. Reopen the native outcome file identity/hash using existing bounded reader. The parent must not manufacture new ready outcome by evaluate_gate_config; validating actual files is required.
file_binding_failure: Do not return fabricated FileBinding on partial publication. Return NOT_ADMITTED with nulls. Existing filename refuses no-overwrite, not idempotent auto-retry. Root separately retains failure and complete scope records.
